text:
Apple (AAPL) Given New $197.00 Price Target at Morgan Stanley Posted by Alanna Baker | Feb 3rd, 2019
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price objective decreased by Morgan Stanley from $211.00 to $197.00 in a research note released on Wednesday morning, Marketbeat Ratings reports. Morgan Stanley currently has an overweight rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
A number of other equities research analysts have also recently commented on AAPL. BTIG Research reduced their price target on shares of Apple from $197.00 to $189.00 and set a buy rating for the company in a report on Wednesday. BMO Capital Markets restated a market perform rating and issued a $153.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Maxim Group restated a hold rating and issued a $160.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Royal Bank of Canada set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a report on Monday, January 28th. Finally, BidaskClub cut shares of Apple from a buy rating to a hold rating in a report on Tuesday, November 13th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have given a buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has an average rating of Hold and a consensus price target of $191.66. Get Apple alerts:
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $166.52 on Wednesday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The firm has a market capitalization of $818.47 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.98, a P/E/G ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.13. Apple has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $4.17 by $0.01. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.72% and a return on equity of 51.09%. As a group, research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.39 EPS for the current year.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Investors of record on Monday, February 11th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.75%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 8th. Apple’s payout ratio is currently 24.52%.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.05% of the stock is owned by company insiders.

MI ADV now owns 41,927 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,614,000 after purchasing an additional 1,115 shares during the period. Taylor Hoffman Wealth Management now owns 34,347 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,424,000 after purchasing an additional 426 shares during the period. Finally, IPG Investment Advisors LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 5.4% in the fourth quarter. IPG Investment Advisors LLC now owns 110,274 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,395,000 after purchasing an additional 5,660 shares during the period. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
